title: Apne Baccho ko na royi
body:
Haay zainab, zainab, haay zainab haay zainab
Zainab sa zamane me azadar Kaha hai..Haay zainab
Hamsheer thi bankar rahi shabbir ki maa hai To mustaqil sheh ki azadaar rahi
<<MINI>>
Apne Bacho ko na royi zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
Umr bhar bhai ko roti hi rahi
<<MINI>>
Apne Bacho ko na royi zainab..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Laashe maidaa se Jo laaye maula
Sajdae shukr ada usne kiya
Mamta kehti rahi maa se fir bhi
Pursa bibi ne bhare ghar ka diya
<<DIVIDER>>
Zikr beto ka Kaha usne kiya
Aaye jab shaame ghareeba me Ali
Yaad kamsin ki rahi pyaas use
Itna mamta ka tha ehsaas use
<<DIVIDER>>
Saamne madare asghar ke Kabhi
Apna ek haath kaleje pe rakhe
Uth Gai duniya se rote rote
Ghame akbar ki sina Aise lagi
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis taraf auno mohammad ke the sar
Raah me ki nahi us simt nazar
Dekh kar ghazi ka sar roti rahi
Sar Jo zinda me shahido k mile
<<DIVIDER>>
Pyaar tha Kitna use bhai se
Sar liye god me wo baithi rahi
Banke wo auno mohd ki bahen
is tarah royi laraz utha watan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab khabar fatema sughra ko mili
Maane beto ke Jo hujre dekhe
Aasu aankho se takallum Nikle
Pehle usdin se na baad uske Kabhi
